scripts.preview:prepare: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/worker preview:assets
scripts.build: pnpm run build:core && pnpm -r --filter '!@edgechat/worker' --filter '!@edgechat/messaging-core' --if-present run build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/worker build
scripts.test:pwa: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web test:pwa
scripts.test:pwa:firefox: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web test:pwa:firefox
scripts.test:pwa:webkit: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web test:pwa:webkit
scripts.test:pwa:matrix: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web test:pwa:matrix
scripts.test:messaging: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web smoke:local
scripts.load:local: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web build && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web load:local
scripts.check: pnpm run db:migrations:check && pnpm run db:types:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.check:release: pnpm run check && pnpm run security:audit && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web smoke:local && pnpm run test:browser:matrix && pnpm --filter @edgechat/web test:pwa:matrix
